content:
The average distance from Earth to the Sun is approximately **93 million miles** or **150 million kilometers**.

This distance is called an **Astronomical Unit (AU)**, which is used as a standard unit for measuring distances within our solar system. So Earth is, by definition, 1 AU from the Sun.

The actual distance varies slightly throughout the year because Earth's orbit is slightly elliptical:
- **Closest point (perihelion)**: ~ 91.4 million miles (147.1 million km) - occurs in early January
- **Farthest point (aphelion)**: About 94.5 million miles (152.1 million km) - occurs in early July
